## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical, end-to-end handling of external API bottlenecks within a CNPA stack, including backpressure, caching, and idempotent semantics across HTTP, DB, and Kafka. It tests decision-making under load and how to validate impact.

## Key Concepts
- Backpressure and rate limiting
- Caching strategies (TTL, Redis)
- Idempotent writes across DB and Kafka
- Kafka producer tuning (acks, in-flight, idempotence)
- End-to-end validation under peak load

## Code Example
```javascript
async function enrich(event) {
  if (!cache.has(event.key)) {
    const data = await externalLookup(event.key)
    cache.set(event.key, data)
    // enqueue enriched event and upsert to Postgres
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you measure tail latency under burst traffic?
- How would you handle cache stampede and external API faults during peak load?
